articles.title: Trump Says Iran Deal Isn't Good Enough Yet — What's the Hold-Up?
articles.summary: President Trump says he's 'not satisfied' with the Iran deal. Iran's TV shared a draft, but the White House called it fake. Talks continue, but Trump warns strikes could resume.

articles.title: U.S. Says White South Africans Face Emergency — South Africa Says 'No Way'
articles.summary: The Trump administration says there's a humanitarian emergency for white Afrikaners in South Africa and will let 10,000 more into the U.S. as refugees. But South Africa and Afrikaner groups say that's not true.

articles.title: Labour Party Fight: Burnham Says Blair Doesn't Get How Hard Life Is for People
articles.summary: Andy Burnham, who may run for Labour leader, says former PM Tony Blair 'doesn't mention inequality once' in a big essay. Burnham says inequality is why people are turning away from the political center.
